## Notes

Gemini core; reasons about goals, explains actions, converses, answers questions about environment; follows sketches, emoji, multiple languages; unseen games ASKA and MineDojo and Genie 3 worlds; self-improvement from Gemini-proposed tasks and rewards. Limited research preview for academics and developers.
